newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHISPANK GROUP BALANCE SHEET UP 12.5PCT.
newsitem.headline: UHISPANK GROUP BALANCE SHEET UP 12.5PCT.

text.p: Uhispank said on Wednesday that its group's balance sheet as of March 31 was 4.3 billion kroons compared to 3.8 billion kroons at the end of 1996, an increase of 12.5 percent.
The group's total shareholders' equity was 377 million kroons at the end of March compared to 350 million kroons at the end of December 1996, the bank added in a statement.
The amount of cash on the bank's books decreased to 498.4 million kroons at the end of March from 574.8 million kroons at the end of December.
Funds due from other banks decreased from 567.5 million kroons to 420.3 million kroons.
Loans increased by 36.3 percent to 2.5 billion kroons from 1.9 billion kroons, the bank said.
In liabilities, total deposits increased from 3.2 billion kroons to 3.7 billion kroons, with term deposits increasing from 1.4 billion kroons to 1.8 billion kroons.
